name: Rozenrite Meguru
original_name: ローゼンライト 運
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend, a 3rd year university student.
He's half Japanese with a German father. He meets up with the protagonist again after seven years of being away in Germany. 
In the other world he is the prince of a wealthy southern country.
A relaxed guy who is popular with the girls. He's supposedly pretty skilled in fighting when he is forced to resort to it.
